- Rising health consciousness driving demand for cold-pressed, fortified and value-added edible oils, creating opportunities for branded players
- Castor oil outlook positive on growing …

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- India continues to meet more than half of its edible oil requirement through imports (palm, soybean, sunflower oil), exposing the industry to volatility in global commodity prices, foreign exchange movements, import duty changes and supply-demand imbalances in producing countries
- The edible oil and castor oil businesses are exposed to fluctuations in international commodity prices and foreign exchange movements affecting procurement costs and operating margins
- Adverse weather in key exporting/producing countries, export restrictions, logistics bottlenecks and geopolitical uncertainties can impact raw material availability and pricing
- Fluctuations in freight and logistics costs and changes in import duty structures may impact industry margins and profitability
- Increasing competition from regional and unorganized players, and from alternative vegetable oils and synthetic substitutes in the castor oil business, may impact demand and margins in price-sensitive segments
- Climate-related uncertainties affecting oilseed production and agricultural commodity price fluctuations may impact raw material availability for the edible oil and organic fertilizer businesses
- Demand for castor oil and its derivatives is influenced by global industrial activity across specialty chemicals, pharmaceuticals, personal care and lubricants; any slowdown in these industries or changes in international trade policy may affect export opportunities
- Increasing compliance requirements relating to product quality, traceability, environmental standards and export regulations may impact business performance across the castor oil and organic fertilizer businesses

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Strengthening market position through operational excellence, product innovation, customer-centric strategies, and expansion of distribution and export footprint
- Managing commodity, currency and industry challenges while capitalizing on emerging opportunities across edible oil, castor oil and organic fertilizer businesses
